crossRefs.note: If I wash myself with snow, and cleanse my hands with lye,
yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes will abhor me.
If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and…
Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?
But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?
For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right:
Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?
He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on…
He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.
You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.

translations.web: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.
translations.bsb: Yet God finds occasions against me; He counts me as His enemy.
translations.kjv: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,
translations.asv: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, He counteth me for his enemy:
